component.name: Kelivo
component.summary: LLM chat client for many providers, with MCP, search and assistants

description.p: This is a community package of Kelivo, maintained independently. It repackages the official upstream build unmodified.
Kelivo is a Flutter chat client for large language models that works with many providers, including OpenAI-compatible APIs, Anthropic, Google and local models through Ollama.

ul.li: Assistants with their own model, prompt, tools and parameters.
Web search, MCP servers over HTTP and SSE, skills and memory.
Images, PDF and Word documents, and audio as input; voice input and text-to-speech.
Markdown, code and math rendering, chat export and backup.

description.p: The package has network access for the providers you configure, can record and play audio, and shows an optional tray icon. It has no filesystem grant: chats and settings stay in the application's private per-app directory, and attachments, imports and exports go through the file chooser portal.

Features that start programs on your computer are limited inside the sandbox: MCP servers over STDIO and workspace commands can only run tools that are part of the package, so use MCP servers over HTTP or SSE instead. To let a workspace edit a folder, grant it: flatpak override --user --filesystem=/path/to/folder com.psyche.kelivo. Global hotkeys work on X11 sessions only.
